authored.title: كنتُ
authored.explanation_ar: نستخدم I was لبيان حالة أو دور أو مكان في وقت ماضٍ. لا تثبت was وحدها أن الحالة انتهت نهائيًا أو أنها لم تعد صحيحة الآن.
authored.explanation_en: Use I was to place a state, role, or location at a past time. Was alone does not establish whether it remains true today.
authored.contrast_ar: I was في الماضي، بينما I am للحاضر.
authored.contrast_en: Use was for a past state with I; use am for a present state. Was is followed by a complement here, not a second finite verb.
